resources.string: Recipient: %1$s\n\nThis sends only this report image to the selected provider. Names and other details visible in the image may be included. Your other records and chats are not sent. Results remain drafts until you review and save them.
Check the filled fields against the original before saving.
Some fields could not be read or are unsupported. Check these drafts against the original and fill any gaps manually.
No configured cloud model is available. Add an image-capable cloud model or use local review.
In Personal Health → Health Center functions → Privacy and data, enable online analysis and report images. Each upload still requires confirmation.
This report has changed, was already read, or its original is unavailable. Reopen it to review the current state.
The model did not return readable report fields. The original and local drafts are unchanged.
The image could not be prepared. Try a clear, cropped copy.
The selected model could not read this image. Check that it supports images and that its API is available. Local drafts are unchanged.
